article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Kennedy Okpara had 17 points in Lipscomb's 92-58 victory over Alabama A&M on Sunday. Okpara went 8 of 10 from the field for the Bisons (6-4). Grant Asman scored 15 points and added eight rebounds. Mateo Esmeraldo went 5 of 5 from the field to finish with 14 points. Koron Davis finished with 13 points and six rebounds for the Bulldogs (4-4). Sami Pissis added 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
